info.title: MetalFlow ERP API
info.description: Manufacturing ERP workflow API. Authenticate via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. All errors use `{"error": {code, message, details}}`.

post.description:
Exchange email/password for a short-lived access token. A rotating refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie.

Repeated failures for the same account from the same IP (or many failures from one IP) return 429.

patch.description: Set ``status`` to INACTIVE to deactivate (customers are never hard-deleted; order history is preserved).

post.description: Reserve every outstanding material requirement (all-or-nothing). Fails with the shortages if stock is insufficient.
Move to the next stage of the job's route. Stages cannot be skipped.
Report a batch of good and scrapped units; consumes allocated material for both.
PASS approves (inspected − defects) units into finished goods. FAIL approves nothing and holds the good units for reinspection.

post.description: Upload PDF, TXT, Markdown or DOCX (max MAX_UPLOAD_MB). New uploads are DRAFT until approved.
Approve a draft version. The previously approved version is archived (history is kept).
Soft-delete: archived documents are kept but no longer used by the assistant.
